description: Issue-area knowledge schema for retail and commercial lease analysis. Defines expected coverage, applicability gating, exposure statements, caution signals, and negative-space clues.
notes: v1.1: Added applicability gating. v1.1.1: Removed bare 'security' from LP-04 activation_clues. v1.1.2: LP-12 activation_clues tightened to prevent false positives on default/remedies language. v1.1.3: LP-14 extended with partial-abatement expected_element and 'wholly untenantable only' unfavorable-pattern detection. v1.1.4: LP-13 covered_unfavorable extended to detect materially asymmetric mutual indemnification (per cross-model audit 2026-04-28). LP-11 rule precedence clarified between covered_unfavorable and potentially_unenforceable per same audit. v1.1.5: exposure_statement field on LP-02, LP-03, LP-08, LP-10, LP-12, LP-17 extended from string to object with tenant/landlord/neutral perspective variants. v1.2.0: Added LP-19 Utilities (required), LP-20 Exclusivity (conditional, extracted from LP-05), LP-21 Guaranty of Lease (conditional, promoted from discovered_provision_patterns). LP-05 expected_elements updated: removed 'exclusive use right scope' (now LP-20's responsibility); related_issue_areas updated to include LP-20. discovered_provision_patterns updated: removed 'Guaranty' pattern (now LP-21).

coverage_states.covered: Provision present and consistent with standard form
coverage_states.covered_unfavorable: Present but materially one-sided against tenant
coverage_states.partial: Some expected elements present, others missing or weakened
coverage_states.ambiguous: Present but interpretation-dependent; practical effect unclear
coverage_states.missing: Issue area expected in this lease but provision is absent
coverage_states.broken_xref: Provision references a section, exhibit, or defined term not found in the document
coverage_states.potentially_unenforceable: Structural or legal defect that may limit enforceability
coverage_states.review_needed: Insufficient evidence to assert a state; surface for human judgment
coverage_states.not_applicable: Issue area does not apply to this lease based on exclusion clues or document type
coverage_states.applicability_unclear: Cannot determine whether this issue area should be present; needs human judgment

applicability_levels.required: Expected in every retail/commercial lease of this type
applicability_levels.conditional: Expected only when specific indicators are present in the document
applicability_levels.optional: May or may not be present; absence is not a concern without other signals

caution_signal_definitions.common_dispute_area: Frequently litigated provision type; outcome heavily fact-dependent
caution_signal_definitions.governing_law_sensitive: Practical effect varies significantly by jurisdiction
caution_signal_definitions.landlord_leverage_point: Landlord typically holds stronger enforcement position if disputed
caution_signal_definitions.tenant_leverage_point: Tenant holds strong position; landlord enforcement limited
caution_signal_definitions.potentially_unenforceable: Known structural defect or clause pattern with enforceability concerns
caution_signal_definitions.cascade_risk: Change to this provision may silently affect other provisions via cross-reference

issue_areas.name: Rent & Payment Terms
expected_elements: late payment fee or penalty mechanism
additional rent definition (what constitutes additional rent)

coverage_state_rules.missing: No rent provision found in document
coverage_state_rules.partial: Base rent defined but late fee, due date, or additional rent definition absent
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: References rent schedule or exhibit not present in document
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Late fee grace period removed or shortened below 5 days

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: No enforceable rent obligation; landlord has no clear basis for payment demand or default notice
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Tenant's payment obligation and enforcement timeline undefined; creates ambiguity in default proceedings
negative_space_clues: Section marked 'Reserved' or 'Intentionally Omitted'
Reference to 'Exhibit A — Rent Schedule' with no Exhibit A attached
Blank dollar amount placeholder not filled in
common_tenant_modifications: Grace period extensions (5 days → 10 days)
Reduced late fee percentage
Removal of additional rent catch-all definition

issue_areas.name: Rent Escalation
expected_elements: annual increase mechanism (fixed percentage or CPI)

coverage_state_rules.missing: No escalation provision found and no flat-rent exclusion language present
coverage_state_rules.partial: Escalation mechanism defined but cap or calculation method absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: CPI reference present but index not specified
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: No cap on CPI increases
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: Document explicitly states rent is fixed for the full term

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Rent frozen at initial amount for entire term; landlord loses inflation protection

exposure_statement.tenant: No rent escalation cap; tenant bears uncapped exposure to inflation-driven rent increases over the lease term
exposure_statement.landlord: No rent escalation cap; landlord retains pricing flexibility but bears the dispute risk that comes with uncapped or formula-driven increases
exposure_statement.neutral: Rent escalation lacks a cap or fully defined calculation methodology; future rent increases may become disputed or difficult to price over the lease term

negative_space_clues: Escalation section header present but body blank or marked Reserved
Cross-reference to CPI index definition absent from Definitions article
common_tenant_modifications: CPI cap addition (e.g. maximum 3% per year)
Fixed-percentage substituted for uncapped CPI
First escalation deferred one year

issue_areas.name: Lease Term & Renewal
expected_elements: rent at renewal (formula or fair market value mechanism)

coverage_state_rules.partial: Term defined but renewal options, notice periods, or renewal rent mechanism absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Renewal at 'fair market value' with no determination mechanism defined
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: References commencement conditions defined in Work Letter or exhibit not present
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Renewal notice period unusually short (under 90 days)

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Lease duration undefined; tenancy may be at-will or interpreted as month-to-month

exposure_statement.tenant: Term and renewal rights unclear; tenant may lose right to remain in premises or face holdover penalties
exposure_statement.landlord: Renewal mechanism undefined; landlord faces uncertainty over future occupancy and has weakened leverage to reset rent or terms at expiration
exposure_statement.neutral: Lease term and renewal rights are incompletely defined; the absence of a renewal rent mechanism leaves both occupancy continuity and pricing unresolved at expiration

negative_space_clues: Renewal option section header with body struck or marked Reserved
Reference to 'Option to Renew' in Table of Contents but section absent from body
common_tenant_modifications: Extended notice period for renewal (90 days → 12 months)
Added renewal options (1 → 2 or 3)
Capped renewal rent at fixed percentage over expiring rent

issue_areas.name: Security Deposit
issue_areas.notes: Bare 'security' removed from activation_clues v1.1.1 — too broad.

coverage_state_rules.missing: Deposit referenced in lease header or recitals but no deposit provision found
coverage_state_rules.partial: Amount defined but return timeline or deduction conditions absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Return deadline unusually long (over 60 days)
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: No deposit references found anywhere in document

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: If deposit was negotiated, landlord has no documented security mechanism
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Deposit obligation referenced but terms undefined; return and deduction rights unprotected
negative_space_clues: Deposit amount shown as blank or $0.00 in lease summary
Letter of credit alternative referenced but terms not defined
common_tenant_modifications: Reduced deposit amount
Burn-down schedule (deposit reduces over time)
Shortened return deadline

issue_areas.name: Permitted Use
issue_areas.notes: Cascade risk: force majeure definition changes can alter continuous operation obligations.

coverage_state_rules.partial: Use defined but continuous operation, prohibited use restrictions, or co-tenancy language absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Use defined broadly without specific business description
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Permitted use cross-references definition not present in document
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Continuous operation obligation present with no force majeure carve-out

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: No restriction on how tenant uses space; may conflict with other tenant exclusives in the center
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Use restrictions absent or undefined; tenant may face exclusive use violations or continuous operation penalties
negative_space_clues: Exclusive use clause header present but body blank
Reference to 'Exhibit B — Exclusive Use Area' with no exhibit attached
common_tenant_modifications: Broadened permitted use description
Weakened continuous operation obligation (shall → may)
Added co-tenancy condition tied to anchor tenant

issue_areas.name: Maintenance & Repairs

coverage_state_rules.partial: General allocation present but HVAC, structural, or response times absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Tenant bears HVAC replacement cost with no age or condition cap
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: HVAC responsibility stated as 'shared' without clear allocation formula

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Maintenance obligations default to tenant under many jurisdictions
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Maintenance allocation undefined; tenant may bear unexpected capital repair costs including structural and HVAC replacement
negative_space_clues: HVAC section header present but body struck or blank
Landlord repair obligation section marked Reserved
common_tenant_modifications: Landlord bears HVAC replacement cost above threshold amount
Structural repair obligation shifted to landlord

issue_areas.name: Common Area Maintenance (CAM)
issue_areas.notes: Not applicable in gross or full-service leases.

coverage_state_rules.missing: CAM references present in lease but no CAM provision found
coverage_state_rules.partial: Share calculation present but exclusions, cap, or audit rights absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: No annual CAM cap; audit rights absent or time-limited to 30 days
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Proportionate share defined by landlord's reasonable determination with no formula
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: Gross or full-service lease structure confirmed

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant may owe undefined share of all building operating expenses with no audit protection
issue_areas.exposure_statement: CAM exposure uncapped and unauditable; tenant cannot verify or challenge operating expense pass-throughs
negative_space_clues: CAM cap provision header present but percentage blank
Audit rights section marked Reserved or Intentionally Omitted
Excluded expenses list cross-references exhibit not attached
common_tenant_modifications: 5% annual CAM increase cap added
Capital expenditure exclusion added
Management fee cap (typically 15% of operating expenses)

issue_areas.name: Insurance Requirements
expected_elements: tenant commercial general liability minimum ($1M per occurrence, $2M aggregate standard)

coverage_state_rules.partial: Liability minimum present but additional insured, property coverage, or waiver of subrogation absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Coverage minimums unusually high; waiver of subrogation absent
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Named insured requirement conflicts with standard policy structure

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant may operate uninsured; landlord has no recourse against tenant insurer for losses

exposure_statement.tenant: Insurance obligations incompletely defined; tenant may face uncovered losses and disputed coverage scope without a clear subrogation waiver
exposure_statement.landlord: Insurance obligations incompletely defined; landlord lacks reliable recourse against tenant insurers for premises-related losses and has no subrogation waiver to limit cross-claims
exposure_statement.neutral: Insurance requirements are incomplete; the missing waiver of subrogation leaves either party exposed to recovery actions by the other's insurer following a covered loss

negative_space_clues: Waiver of subrogation section present but obligation direction reversed or blank
Certificate delivery obligation cross-references deleted notice section
common_tenant_modifications: Reduced minimum coverage amounts
Removal of business interruption requirement
Mutual waiver of subrogation (one-way → two-way)

issue_areas.name: Subletting & Assignment
expected_elements: affiliate exception (no consent required for related entities)
profit sharing on sublet above base rent
recapture right (landlord can terminate and lease directly)
assignment in connection with sale of business

coverage_state_rules.partial: Consent requirement present but affiliate exception, recapture, or profit sharing absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Landlord consent in sole and absolute discretion; no affiliate exception
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Affiliate defined by cross-reference to definition section not present in document

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Assignment rights undefined; tenant unable to sell business or transfer lease in routine transactions
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Assignment rights absent or over-restricted; tenant cannot execute routine business transactions including sale of business
negative_space_clues: Affiliate exception section marked Reserved
Sale-of-business exception cross-references deleted exhibit
common_tenant_modifications: Reasonableness standard added ('not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed')
Affiliate exception broadened (parent, subsidiary, successor entities)
Sale-of-business exception expanded to include asset sales

issue_areas.name: Alterations & Improvements
expected_elements: threshold for required landlord approval (dollar amount or scope)
landlord contribution to tenant improvements (if any)
ownership of improvements at lease end

coverage_state_rules.partial: Approval threshold present but removal obligation, ownership, or lien discharge absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Landlord may require removal of all tenant improvements at discretion
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Tenant improvement allowance cross-references Work Letter exhibit not attached

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant may not make any alterations without implied landlord consent; improvements may revert to landlord

exposure_statement.tenant: Alteration rights undefined; tenant faces removal obligation uncertainty and potential forfeiture of improvement investment
exposure_statement.landlord: Tenant improvement allowance undefined; landlord faces uncertainty over its capital contribution exposure and the scope of improvements it may inherit at lease end
exposure_statement.neutral: Alteration rights and improvement-cost allocation are undefined; ownership and removal obligations for tenant-funded improvements at lease end are unresolved

negative_space_clues: Tenant improvement allowance section marked Reserved or amount is $0
Work Letter cross-referenced but exhibit absent from document
common_tenant_modifications: Approval threshold increased (above $10,000 or $25,000)
Removal obligation limited to trade fixtures only
Landlord required to designate removal items at time of approval

issue_areas.name: Default & Remedies
expected_elements: monetary default definition and cure period (typically 5 days)
non-monetary default definition and cure period (typically 30 days)
tenant's right to cure third-party defaults

coverage_state_rules.partial: Monetary default present but non-monetary default, notice requirement, or cure period absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Cure period unusually short (under 30 days for non-monetary); OR landlord remedies aggressive but conditioned on prior notice and cure opportunity
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Remedies cross-reference deleted exhibit or section
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Self-help re-entry language permitting landlord to re-enter and remove tenant or property without judicial process AND without explicit reservation of tenant's right to legal process; covered_unfavorable governs when re-entry language is aggressive but conditioned on notice and cure

issue_areas.notes: Rule precedence v1.1.4: covered_unfavorable governs aggressive remedies that are still gated by notice/cure procedures. potentially_unenforceable is reserved for self-help language that bypasses judicial process entirely. When both could arguably apply, covered_unfavorable is the safer default; potentially_unenforceable should require explicit absence of legal-process reservation (e.g. clause states landlord 'may re-enter without legal process' or equivalent).
issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Landlord remedies limited to common law; no contractual right to accelerate rent or re-enter
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Default and remedy framework absent or incomplete; landlord enforcement position significantly weakened
negative_space_clues: Remedy section header present but acceleration clause absent
Notice requirement section marked Reserved
common_tenant_modifications: Extended cure periods (5 days → 10 days monetary; 30 days → 45 days non-monetary)
Notice required before every default declaration
Added third-party cure right (mortgagee or guarantor may cure)

issue_areas.name: Early Termination
exclusion_clues: no right to terminate prior to expiration
issue_areas.notes: Absence is normal and expected. Activation clues tightened v1.1.2 to prevent false positives on default/remedies language.
expected_elements: triggering conditions for early termination right

coverage_state_rules.missing: Termination right referenced elsewhere in lease but no termination provision found
coverage_state_rules.partial: Termination right exists but penalty formula, notice period, or survival obligations absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Termination fee includes unamortized brokerage commissions
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Termination fee formula cross-references amortization schedule exhibit not attached
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: No termination right language anywhere in document; absence is by design

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant has no exit mechanism; full remaining lease obligations survive business failure or relocation

exposure_statement.tenant: No early exit right; tenant bears full term obligation regardless of operational changes
exposure_statement.landlord: No tenant early termination right; landlord retains full-term revenue certainty but loses the ability to recapture and re-let the space if a better tenant emerges
exposure_statement.neutral: No early termination right is defined; full-term obligations persist unless another lease provision independently permits termination

negative_space_clues: Early termination section present but triggering conditions blank
Co-tenancy termination right cross-references anchor tenant definition not in document
common_tenant_modifications: Added termination right after Year 3 or Year 5
Termination fee capped at 6-12 months rent
Co-tenancy clause added (right to terminate if anchor tenant leaves)

issue_areas.name: Indemnification & Liability
expected_elements: exclusion of consequential or punitive damages

coverage_state_rules.partial: One-way indemnification present (tenant → landlord only) without reciprocal protection
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: No liability cap; consequential damages not excluded; OR mutual indemnification structurally present but materially asymmetric (e.g. tenant indemnifies for broad scope including ordinary negligence while landlord indemnification is limited to gross negligence or willful misconduct)
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Indemnification for indemnitee's own gross negligence

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Liability defaults to common law negligence standards
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Indemnification absent or one-sided; tenant bears uncapped liability exposure with no landlord reciprocal protection
negative_space_clues: Landlord indemnification section marked Reserved or deleted
Liability cap provision header present but amount blank
Landlord indemnification limited to gross negligence or willful misconduct while tenant indemnification covers ordinary negligence or all premises accidents
Tenant indemnifies for accidents 'in or about the Premises' regardless of cause without carve-out for landlord's own negligence
common_tenant_modifications: Added mutual/reciprocal indemnification
Added cap on total liability (typically 12-24 months rent)
Excluded consequential, punitive, and special damages

issue_areas.name: Force Majeure
issue_areas.notes: Cascade risk: definition expansions silently affect LP-05 continuous operation obligations. v1.1.3: Added partial-abatement expected_element and 'wholly untenantable only' pattern to covered_unfavorable rule.
expected_elements: definition of qualifying force majeure events
scope of excused obligations (which parties, which obligations)
rent abatement during force majeure period
partial rent abatement or adjustment for operational impairment
termination right if force majeure exceeds threshold period

coverage_state_rules.partial: Events defined but rent abatement, notice requirement, or termination right absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Abatement limited to 'wholly untenantable' standard with no partial abatement for operational impairment; OR tenant required to vacate to claim any abatement; OR force majeure excludes rent obligations entirely
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Force majeure definition includes catch-all language without enumeration

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: No excused performance; common law impossibility doctrine rarely applies to commercial leases
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Force majeure protection absent or limited to total untenantability; tenant may be obligated to pay full rent during partial operational impairment (utility loss, restricted access, regulatory shutdown, HVAC failure) that leaves premises legally occupiable but operationally unusable for the tenant's permitted business
negative_space_clues: Force majeure section present but rent abatement carve-out blank or deleted
Event list ends with 'including without limitation' with body truncated
Abatement available only if premises are 'wholly untenantable' with no partial-impairment mechanism
Abatement conditioned on tenant vacating the premises
common_tenant_modifications: Added pandemics, cyberattacks, supply chain disruptions to event list
Added rent abatement for force majeure periods exceeding 30 days
Added termination right if force majeure exceeds 180 days
Added partial abatement mechanism for operational impairment short of total untenantability

issue_areas.name: Signage Rights
exclusion_clues: tenant shall have no right to install signs
issue_areas.notes: Retail tenants almost always have signage rights.
expected_elements: landlord's right to modify or remove
compliance with code and center standards

coverage_state_rules.missing: No signage provision in a retail lease
coverage_state_rules.partial: Storefront signage addressed but pylon, directory, or approval process absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Landlord may modify or remove signage at any time without notice
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: Non-retail context confirmed; signage not expected

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant has no right to exterior signage; landlord can deny any brand identification at premises
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Signage rights undefined; tenant's brand visibility at premises unprotected and subject to landlord discretion
negative_space_clues: Signage specification cross-references Sign Criteria exhibit not attached
Pylon sign right granted but panel dimensions blank
common_tenant_modifications: Added pylon sign panel right
Minimum sign dimensions specified
Approval timeline specified (30 days; deemed approved if no response)

issue_areas.name: Parking
exclusion_clues: tenant is responsible for own parking
expected_elements: parking space allocation (count or ratio per square foot)
parking cost (included in rent or separately charged)
landlord's right to modify parking area

coverage_state_rules.missing: Parking referenced in lease but no parking provision found
coverage_state_rules.partial: Spaces allocated but cost, reservation status, or modification rights absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Landlord may reduce parking allocation or convert to paid parking at any time
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Parking 'in common with other tenants' without space count or ratio

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: No contractual parking rights; landlord may charge for or eliminate parking access
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Parking rights undefined or unprotected; tenant customers and employees may face parking restrictions without recourse
negative_space_clues: Parking Exhibit referenced but not attached
Reserved space locations cross-reference site plan not included in document
common_tenant_modifications: Minimum space count guaranteed regardless of center reconfiguration
Cost of reserved spaces capped or included in base rent

issue_areas.name: Dispute Resolution
expected_elements: dispute resolution mechanism (mediation, arbitration, or litigation)
attorney fee allocation (one-way or prevailing party)

coverage_state_rules.partial: Governing law present but venue, attorney fee allocation, or jury waiver absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Attorney fees one-way (landlord only); jury trial waived by tenant only
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Mandatory arbitration clause may be unenforceable against certain tenant types

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Dispute venue and cost allocation undefined; may favor party with greater litigation resources

exposure_statement.tenant: Dispute framework absent; attorney fee allocation and venue undefined, creating uncertainty in enforcement cost
exposure_statement.landlord: Dispute framework incomplete; attorney fee allocation and claim limitation periods undefined, creating uncertainty in landlord's enforcement leverage and defense costs
exposure_statement.neutral: Dispute framework is incomplete; the absence of a defined claims-limitation period and clear fee allocation leaves enforcement cost and timing exposure on both sides

negative_space_clues: Attorney fee allocation section blank or marked Reserved
Jury trial waiver section marked Intentionally Omitted
common_tenant_modifications: Prevailing party fee allocation made mutual (not landlord-only)
Jury trial waiver made mutual
Venue changed to tenant's county

issue_areas.name: Holdover Provisions
expected_elements: holdover rent rate (typically 150% of final month's rent)
landlord's right to collect consequential damages from holdover

coverage_state_rules.missing: No holdover provision; holdover tenancy governed by state law default
coverage_state_rules.partial: Holdover rate defined but notice requirement or tenancy characterization absent
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Holdover converts automatically to new 12-month term; consequential damages unlimited
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Holdover rate above 200% may be characterized as penalty clause

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Holdover defaults to state law; tenant may create new full-term tenancy by staying even one day past expiration
issue_areas.exposure_statement: Holdover protection undefined; tenant faces unlimited consequential damage exposure and potential automatic lease renewal
negative_space_clues: Holdover rate multiplier blank
Consequential damages section marked Reserved
common_tenant_modifications: Holdover rate reduced (200% → 150%)
Consequential damages excluded
Month-to-month characterization confirmed (prevents automatic term renewal)

issue_areas.name: Utilities
issue_areas.notes: Required in every commercial lease. Allocation may be tenant-direct (separately metered), pass-through via CAM (LP-07), or landlord-included in gross rent. All three structures are valid; absence of any utility provision is the gap.
expected_elements: identification of covered utilities (electric, gas, water, sewer, telecommunications, trash)
cost allocation method (tenant direct, separately metered, pass-through, or landlord-included)
responsibility for installation and connection costs
rent abatement or remedies for prolonged service interruption

coverage_state_rules.partial: Cost allocation present but interruption remedies, upgrade cost responsibility, or submetering rights absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Utilities allocated to 'appropriate party' or 'as customary' without specification
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: No rent abatement for prolonged utility interruption; OR tenant bears all utility upgrade costs without cap; OR tenant required to pay for shared utility cost without submetering
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Utility allocation cross-references exhibit, schedule, or definition not present in document

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Utility cost allocation and service interruption rights undefined; tenant may face unexpected utility expenses or lose abatement rights during outages, particularly material for tenants with high utility dependency (food service, healthcare, refrigeration-dependent retail)

exposure_statement.tenant: Utility cost allocation and service interruption rights undefined; tenant may face unexpected utility expenses or lose rent abatement during prolonged outages, particularly material for operations dependent on continuous service
exposure_statement.landlord: Utility cost allocation and interruption remedies undefined; landlord may bear costs intended for tenant or face disputes over abatement obligations during third-party utility failures
exposure_statement.neutral: Utility cost allocation and service interruption rights are undefined; both parties face uncertainty over expense responsibility and abatement during outages

negative_space_clues: Utilities listed in lease summary but no allocation provision in body
'Tenant shall pay for all utilities' without submetering or check meter rights
Utility room or service entry referenced but tenant access rights not granted
Service interruption section header present but body blank or marked Reserved
Utility upgrade cost provision references exhibit not attached
common_tenant_modifications: Added rent abatement after 5 or 7 days of utility interruption
Submetering or check meter rights added
Utility upgrade costs allocated to landlord or capped
Cap on tenant's share of shared utility costs

issue_areas.name: Exclusivity
exclusion_clues: tenant has no exclusive use right
landlord retains right to lease to competitors
issue_areas.notes: Extracted from LP-05 in schema v1.2.0. Most retail leases include exclusivity for the tenant's primary business; absence is meaningful for retail tenants but normal for office or industrial tenants. Carve-outs swallow exclusivity if too broad — material question for any retail tenant whose competitive moat depends on this clause.
expected_elements: specific exclusive use scope (protected business activities defined precisely)
carve-outs for existing tenants at center
carve-outs for ancillary or incidental use by other tenants
remedies for landlord violation (rent abatement, damages, termination)
duration of exclusivity (full term or limited period)

coverage_state_rules.missing: Exclusive use referenced elsewhere in lease (e.g., recitals or LP-05) but no standalone exclusivity provision
coverage_state_rules.partial: Exclusive scope defined but remedies, carve-outs, or competing-use definition absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Exclusive use language without specific business definition, or 'reasonable' exclusivity without scope
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Carve-outs effectively swallow the exclusivity (e.g., grocery pharmacy carve-out for a pharmacy tenant); OR no remedies for landlord violation; OR landlord retains unilateral right to modify exclusivity
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Exclusive area or carve-out list cross-references exhibit not attached
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: Document explicitly states no exclusivity, OR tenant type does not warrant exclusivity (office, industrial)

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: Tenant has no protection from competing tenants at the center; landlord may lease adjacent space to direct competitors, eroding tenant's revenue base. Particularly material for retail tenants whose location-based competitive moat is the rationale for the lease

exposure_statement.tenant: Exclusivity protection absent or undefined; tenant has no contractual protection from competing tenants and no enforcement mechanism if landlord violates
exposure_statement.landlord: Exclusivity scope and carve-outs undefined; landlord faces potential disputes over what constitutes 'competing use' and may have leasing flexibility unintentionally constrained
exposure_statement.neutral: Exclusivity scope, carve-outs, and remedies are undefined; both parties face uncertainty over what competition is permitted at the center and what enforcement looks like if exclusivity is violated

negative_space_clues: Exclusive use clause header present but body blank or marked Reserved
Carve-outs section present but list blank
Reference to 'Exhibit C — Exclusive Use Area' or similar with no exhibit attached
Definition of 'competing use' absent from Definitions article
Remedies section blank or limited to 'landlord shall use commercially reasonable efforts'
Radius restriction percentage or distance blank
common_tenant_modifications: Added remedies for violation (rent abatement, termination right after notice and cure)
Tightened definition of 'competing use' to specific SIC/NAICS codes
Limited carve-outs (no general grocery exception for pharmacy tenant)
Added radius restriction (e.g., no competing use within 1 mile)
Extended exclusivity for full lease term including renewal options

issue_areas.name: Guaranty of Lease
exclusion_clues: no personal guarantee shall be required
issue_areas.notes: Promoted from discovered_provision_patterns in schema v1.2.0. Common for newer tenants, smaller tenants, single-purpose entity tenants, or where landlord requires additional credit support beyond the security deposit. Absence is normal for established/creditworthy tenants and not a flag.
expected_elements: identification of guarantor (individual or entity, with address)
scope of guaranteed obligations (rent only, all lease obligations, or specified subset)
guaranty type (full, limited, good guy, burndown)
recourse mechanism (direct action against guarantor, or after exhausting tenant remedies)
duration of guaranty (full lease term, defined period, or until release conditions met)
release conditions (sale of business, hitting financial milestones, vacate and pay obligations met)
survival of guaranty after lease assignment or modification

coverage_state_rules.missing: Guaranty referenced in recitals, signature block, or other lease provisions but no guaranty article or attached guaranty agreement found
coverage_state_rules.partial: Guarantor identified but scope, duration, type, or release conditions absent
coverage_state_rules.ambiguous: Guaranty type unclear (full vs limited not specified); OR 'good guy guaranty' invoked without definition
coverage_state_rules.covered_unfavorable: Guaranty extends beyond lease term with no termination mechanism; OR guarantor remains liable after release of tenant; OR no release conditions defined; OR 'all obligations forever' language without limitation
coverage_state_rules.broken_xref: Lease references separate Guaranty Agreement attached as exhibit but exhibit not present in document
coverage_state_rules.potentially_unenforceable: Guaranty not signed by guarantor; OR notarization required by jurisdiction not present; OR guaranty waives statutory protections that may not be waivable
coverage_state_rules.not_applicable: No guaranty references anywhere in document; tenant alone is responsible

issue_areas.risk_if_missing: If a guaranty was negotiated, landlord has no enforceable third-party recourse if tenant defaults; landlord's credit position is limited to tenant entity assets and the security deposit

exposure_statement.tenant: Guaranty terms incompletely defined; guarantor's scope, duration, and release conditions undefined, creating uncertainty about personal exposure and inability to plan exit from guaranty obligation
exposure_statement.landlord: Guaranty terms incompletely defined; landlord lacks clear enforcement mechanism against guarantor, faces uncertainty over guaranty survival across lease modifications, and may have weakened credit support if guaranty is unenforceable
exposure_statement.neutral: Guaranty terms, scope, recourse, duration, and release conditions are undefined; both parties face uncertainty over the third-party backstop's enforceability and how it interacts with lease modifications or assignment

negative_space_clues: Signature block lists guarantor but no guaranty article in lease body
Recitals or lease summary references guaranty but provision absent
'Good guy guaranty' invoked without definition
Burndown schedule referenced but timing and triggers blank
Release conditions section header present but body blank or marked Reserved
Reference to separate Guaranty Agreement exhibit not attached
Guarantor signature line present but unsigned
common_tenant_modifications: Good guy guaranty (personal liability ends when tenant vacates and pays through vacate date)
Burndown schedule (guaranty amount reduces over time as tenant performs)
Release on financial milestones (revenue, net worth, or operating history thresholds)
Cap on guaranty amount (e.g., 12 months rent maximum exposure)
Release on assignment of lease to qualified assignee
Limited guaranty scope (rent only, not all lease obligations)

discovered_provision_patterns.description: Common non-standard provisions discovered in tenant leases during CAM analysis (CUSTOM-XX entries).

patterns.name: Co-Tenancy
patterns.coverage_concern: Tenant seeks rent reduction or termination right tied to anchor tenant presence

patterns.name: Percentage Rent
patterns.coverage_concern: Revenue-based rent above natural breakpoint; calculation methodology and reporting obligations critical

patterns.name: SNDA
patterns.coverage_concern: Tenant's right to remain in occupancy if landlord's lender forecloses

patterns.name: Hazardous Materials
patterns.coverage_concern: Tenant's environmental obligations; definition of prohibited substances and remediation responsibilities

patterns.name: Radius Restriction
patterns.coverage_concern: Restriction on tenant operating competing locations within defined radius

patterns.name: Relocation
patterns.coverage_concern: Landlord's right to relocate tenant to different premises

patterns.name: Continuous Operations
patterns.coverage_concern: Obligation to remain open and operating specific hours; penalties for going dark
